world: a white marble temple complex floating high above a sea of clouds, with tall ivory colonnades, golden domes, broken arches drifting in the air, floating stairways, soft morning sunlight streaming through the clouds, feathers drifting on the wind, and distant floating islands with waterfalls pouring into the clouds

b-cherub.describe: a small apprentice angel child with slightly too-big fluffy white wings and a few stray feathers, a crooked little golden halo, short curly hair, a simple white tunic with a gold sash, holding a tiny wooden bow with light arrows, a curious and mischievous expression, hovering just above a marble floor tile

b-paladin.describe: a towering knight statue of white marble come to life, heavy carved plate armor with gold inlays, a huge kite shield engraved with a sun emblem, a long holy sword glowing with pale gold light, cracks in the stone glowing softly from within, faceless closed helm with a radiant visor slit, standing guard on temple steps

b-seraph.describe: a majestic six-winged seraph with long flowing platinum hair, serene but stern face, ornate golden armor over flowing white and gold robes, a radiant halo ring of light behind the head, holding a long flaming sword of white-gold fire, six enormous luminous wings spread wide filling the sky, hovering above the highest altar of the temple with beams of light around
